title: Shopping bag

location.series: Pentagram / Natural History Museum case study

slide_intent: Carry recognition beyond the visit, because a useful object creates further encounters with the institution.
strategic_value: A large multicolor symbol on a purple bag can turn a retail purchase into a portable reminder of the Museum.
demonstration: A purple paper shopping bag has a large centered radial symbol and a small white museum name below.
practical_value: Judge the balance between a dominant mark and a supporting name on a carry object.

content_islands.name: Bag face
content_islands.spec: Center the symbol on the purple face and place the name beneath it.

content_islands.name: Physical form
content_islands.spec: Retain the handles, side folds and cast shadow to show the printed object.

reference_purposes.Application: A purple paper shopping bag has a large centered radial symbol and a small white museum name below.
